TÜV SÜD – A global leader in the field of testing, inspection, management system certification and product certification renowned for quality, integrity and technical excellence.
Established more than 150 years ago in Germany, TÜV SÜD is a leading global provider of technical services with more than 28,000 highly skilled employees across 1,000 offices worldwide. TÜV SÜD offers a wide range of testing & product certification, inspection, auditing & system certification, training and knowledge services. We are a premium quality, safety, and sustainability solutions provider.
 Introduction
 The system administrator is responsible for the stable, secure and efficient operation of the IT systems in the application environment. The aim of the position is to ensure the smooth operation of the application landscape, to ensure system availability and to continuously improve IT security and system quality.
 Tasks
 System administration of the defined application(s) 
Monitoring and ensuring the operation of the application servers
Close cooperation and interface function to: Database Team, Testing and Approval Team, Operations Manager (BV) , Infrastructure Team
 Server and system administration
Installation, configuration and maintenance of servers and operating systems
Planning, coordinating and carrying out regular system updates and backups
Installation and rollout of new versions on test systems
Installation and rollout versions on production systems
Installation and maintenance of software on test and production systems
Ensure system stability and compliance with operational standards
 User and Support Services
Provision of 2nd level support for technical inquiries and faults in the area of defined applications
Analysis and resolution of complex technical problems
Support of departmental projects, especially in the field of mobility
Creation, maintenance and updating of technical documentation
Temporary takeover and support of smaller applications
Participation in IT projects for the introduction of new technologies and systems
Implementation of technical adjustments and measures resulting from annual penetration tests
Support in the development and implementation of automation solutions in the team
Ensuring the exchange of information and transparency about the ongoing activities of other system administrators in the application environment
 Qualifications
Successfully completed studies, e.g. in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable vocational qualification
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows environments (Server/Client)
Very good knowledge of SQL databases
Extensive experience in IT operations (applications and infrastructure)
Good knowledge of IT service management processes
Strong analytical skills
Very good communication and teamwork skills
High level of sensitivity when dealing with customers
Very good German and English language skills
